propositions: Impact-present close operations exhibit O(unique_candidates × tracker_size) scaling due to per-candidate full tracker-directory walks in resolve_ticket_id's short-id and generic-prefix branches.

Current implementation performs one os.listdir(tracker_dir) per historical reference candidate during commit_impact.referencing_commits, despite alias resolution already being bounded by prior fix 5c64deff.

Red-first regression test confirms the short-id and generic-prefix resolution branches scale linearly with non-alias candidates (82 scans for 80 candidates), violating acceptance criterion that tracker cost must be bounded to a single index build.

Fix introduces build_resolver_scan_index to precompute sorted directory names and alias mappings once, then resolves short-id and generic-prefix candidates via bisect rather than per-candidate listings.

After repair, tracker-root os.listdir calls reduce from 82 to 1 for a workload with 80 non-alias candidates, while preserving all reference-matching semantics, ambiguity behavior, descendant credit, and file-impact enforcement.
